title: Agent observability and trace privacy
subtitle: Connect requests, tool outcomes, model spend, and business results.
goal: Explain what happened during one task without exporting everything
intro: Useful telemetry preserves causal context and outcomes while limiting sensitive content.
case: A tool function returns normally but the business operation was rejected.
Telemetry counts the task outcome rather than only exception-free execution.
Green HTTP metrics can hide widespread failed work.
